fields.name: Ariel

conversion.limit_scope: The amount obtainable through morphing is limited separately for each Hard expedition.

fields.excess_fragment_exchange: 1 Ariel Fragment can be exchanged for 5 Enhance Stones without a stated exchange limit.
fields.notes: Board existence and currency loop are supported by the Global patch notes as transcribed by Aion2t and cross-linked to NC's official notice. Detailed board node layout, node count and stat values are intentionally left blank until verified from the Global client/API.
fields.inventory_scope_note: This six-board inventory is corroborated by the Global 2026-10-21 client research guide; the detailed board node maps and exact values are not included here.

evidence.note: NC official Global patch-note page for Oct. 20 (PDT) / Oct. 21 (CEST); page is client-rendered in the web fetch, so details are cross-checked against the linked transcription below.

Patch transcription states that Global adds the Ariel Daevanion board; 100 Ariel Fragments convert to one bound Ariel crystal, with a limit of 30 conversions per character and separate per-dungeon morph limits.
Independent research guide reports the 21 October Global client build contains Ariel as a PvE board. Its detailed node data is not copied into this record.

This guide reports five Global boards and explicitly says it was checked against the Oct. 7 patch / reviewed Oct. 12. It predates the Oct. 21 Ariel update, so it is a stale snapshot rather than evidence that Ariel is absent in the current build.

Current guide updated Oct. 21 and citing the Global client build of Oct. 21 lists six boards: Nezekan, Zikel, Vaizel, Triniel, Azphel and Ariel. Used only to corroborate the board inventory; node values are not imported.
